srList.sentence: Samples of PC-3 cells, DU 145 cells and LNCaP cells were prepared and incubated with fluorescently labeled SPION/CCh/N-cad (the number of added nanoparticles corresponded to the anti-N-cadherin antibody concentration of 2.5 µg/mL) for 1 hour at 4 °C.

sentenceParts.c: Samples of PC-3 cells, DU 145 cells and LNCaP cells were prepared and incubated with fluorescently labeled SPION/CCh/N-cad (the number of added nanoparticles corresponded to the anti-N-cadherin antibody concentration of 2.5 µg/mL) for 1 hour at 4 °C.

srList.sentence: The obtained results have confirmed that the level of N-cadherin is the highest for the PC-3 cells, lower for DU 145 and no N-cadherin was observed for LNCaP cell line.

srList.sentence: Co-cultures of cells: PC-3 and DU 145 (cell number ratio 1:1), PC-3 and LNCaP (cell number ratio 1:4) were obtained by simultaneous seeding of cell mixtures on glass coverslips and incubated until a monolayer of cells was observed.
